The '''Coraqii valley''' was a valley that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The [[Ishkik caverns]], a series of extensive underground caves, could be accessed from the valley. The giant [[Kilassin]] [[Tassa'to]] lived in the Coraqii valley and every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Tarasin]] [[Hiironi irstat]] sent two of their best [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] to try and hunt the creature.
